title: RUN OVER MOMENTS READ CLEARLY
why: Critic scored both real run-over cards 3/5: uneven stat columns, small captions and a busy backdrop. Both players now keep a fixed four-stat grid, share actual deaths on the score wire, and read 20px captions over the quiet 80 percent scrim with 6px blur. Moments have a divider and 24px row gaps; the crown uses a small gold rule instead of a lime value. The card keeps the style guide 720px dialog width. Watch in playtest: compare both player rows and the six moments at 1080p and 4k; their columns and deaths should agree. No save key, seeded draw or combat values change.
now: Run over stats align in both windows, with larger moment captions and a quieter backdrop.
